answer_1.quote: Following previous works' success in generating high-quality data using LLMs, we generate OpenToM stories using a four-stage human-in-the-loop generation pipeline

answer_2.quote: As all the OpenToM questions are formulated as binary or ternary classification tasks and considering that the labels are not uniformly distributed, we evaluate model performance using the macro-averaged F1 scores

answer_4.quote: We take measures to mitigate spurious correlation in all questions... We manually revise such narratives to reduce the reporting bias
answer_4.guideline: examine each narrative to ensure that (1) the answers to the ToM questions are not directly given in the narrative, (2) The narrative content aligns with commonsense knowledge, and (3) there is no significant lexical overlaps between the narrative and the corresponding ToM questions
